10378|4fa5b9c3.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|4fa5b9c3.text: Where can I send you today $c?

10378|6bdb24d7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|6bdb24d7.text: Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.

10378|8b4f80e7.name: Omusa Thunderhorn
10378|8b4f80e7.text: Though the Crossroads seems to be the center of activity in The Barrens, I prefer the quietude of Camp Taurajo.  Where shall I send you?

10428|74518b5c.name: Motega Firemane
10428|74518b5c.text:
Whitereach Post started off as a small hunting camp... Now, everyone wants to set up shop and call this home.

<Motega shrugs his shoulder>

248197|cc5aee35.name: Gor'mak
248197|cc5aee35.text: You won't find better equipment anywhere else!

260093|58279558.name: Garen Largo
260093|58279558.text: Do you require training in the ways of the light?

263646|53fff4bc.name: Rugbul Boomfirst
263646|53fff4bc.text: I am sorry, $c, but you are not experienced enough yet to enter Darkspear Islands.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3309|2f8d506f.name: Karus
3309|2f8d506f.text: Besides the Grunts outside, my brothers and I fought at the battle of Hyjal. Any who seek to steal from the bank must face us first.

3309|6b36598f.name: Karus
3309|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

4452|a84fd61d.name: Kravel Koalbeard
4452|a84fd61d.text:
Come a little closer.  We have important matters to discuss, you and I.

And some of them we don't want everyone to hear...

4453|f1c43d2c.name: Wizzle Brassbolts
4453|f1c43d2c.text: Be careful where you put that foot of yours, mister. We're not all blessed with the lofty height of a $r.

6746|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Pala
6746|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

1102-progress.name: Auld Stonespire
1102-progress.text:
Once I know the foul beasts of Razorfen Kraul have been driven from their foul lair, I will be able to rest in peace, knowing that revenge has been served.

Have you the driven the quilboar from the Kraul? Do you bring to me good news in the form of Razorflank's heart?
1102-progress.title: A Vengeful Fate

2841-progress.name: Nogg
2841-progress.text: I don't see any blueprints. Did you hide them somewhere on your body or are you just standing around here to irritate me?
2841-progress.title: Rig Wars

4542-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
4542-progress.text: What do you want, $c? An urgent message - for me?
4542-progress.title: Message to Freewind Post

4601-progress.name: The Sparklematic 5200
4601-progress.text: It would seem that the device needs some sort of grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to get the contraption working.  So long as both are present, the Sparklematic 5200 should work...
4601-progress.title: The Sparklematic 5200!

4603-progress.name: The Sparklematic 5200
4603-progress.text: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
4603-progress.title: More Sparklematic Action

4767-progress.name: Elu
4767-progress.text: $N, have you retrieved the wyvern eggs that I seek? I'm really anxious to start my wind rider training!
4767-progress.title: Wind Rider

4821-progress.name: Hagar Lightninghoof
4821-progress.text: I must know more about this mysterious egg, who knows what will hatch from it.
4821-progress.title: Alien Egg

5062-progress.name: Magatha Grimtotem
5062-progress.text:
So, Motega Firemain sends word of Arikara...well now that is grave news.

<Magatha looks around.>

Arikara is a deadly creature born only to seek vengeance against those who have committed heinous acts.

<Magatha smiles.>
5062-progress.title: Sacred Fire

5064-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5064-progress.text: Have you discovered what the Grimtotem are up to?
5064-progress.title: Grimtotem Spying

5147-progress.name: Cliffwatcher Longhorn
5147-progress.text: Have you any news of that murderous Arnak Grimtotem?
5147-progress.title: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem

550-progress.name: Varimathras
550-progress.text: What brings a $c all the way to the Undercity from the battlefield?
550-progress.title: Battle of Hillsbrad

6441-progress.name: Pixel
6441-progress.text: I hope you can be quick about getting those horns, $N. I'm heading back to Ratchet soon!
6441-progress.title: Satyr Horns

6462-progress.name: Mitsuwa
6462-progress.text: Did you find the charms, $N?  Every moment the furbolgs possess those sacred items, my blood boils with rage!
6462-progress.title: Troll Charm

6522-progress.name: Varimathras
6522-progress.text: What business is it you wish to speak of, $N? You must feel it is important if you continue to pester me.
6522-progress.title: An Unholy Alliance

6581-progress.name: Pixel
6581-progress.text:
Direct from Ratchet, the Warsong saw blades! Yep, I have them right here.

..But what sort of payment do you have for me? You can't just take them, you know! My time isn't cheap!

What I really need is a good gun to carry with me on my travels. A girl's gotta protect herself, you know? There's a gun I really like that I'm sure an engineer would have no problem making.

So, if you bring me a deadly blunderbuss, I'll give you the saw blade shipment. Do we have a deal?
6581-progress.title: Warsong Saw Blades

6621-progress.name: Karang Amakkar
6621-progress.text: Did you defeat Chief Murgut, $N?  Did you retrieve his Foulweald Totem?
6621-progress.title: King of the Foulweald

91900-progress.name: Dokimi
91900-progress.text: Another delivery! Fantastic. Set it over by the pile and we can discuss your compensation.
91900-progress.title: A Sealed Crate

97583-accept.name: Excitable Slime
97583-accept.text:
<The little slime seems delighted and is attempting to mirror your motions as you dance. It begins to look weary though.

The little slime hovers over a bit of sludge and absorbs it, looking slightly rejuvenated.

It seems all of this dancing has tuckered it out. Perhaps someone in the Undercity canals sells more of this nutritious sludge?>
97583-accept.title: WRIGGLE.

97583-complete.name: Excitable Slime
97583-complete.text: <The slime shudders with newfound energy. It seems to want to follow you, now that it has associated you with food.>
97583-complete.title: WRIGGLE.

97583-progress.name: Excitable Slime
97583-progress.text: <The slime seems to regard you with interest.>
97583-progress.title: WRIGGLE.

98069-progress.name: Jandia
98069-progress.text: Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
98069-progress.title: Stolen Freewind Supplies
